findings.finding: BWM world-model plus beam solved 73/110; corresponding proposer without world model solved 5/110.
findings.scope: PlanBench Blocksworld-hard, 6-15 blocks, trained on <=6 blocks, one training seed.
limitations: Assisted system result; does not prove unaided standalone internalization.
No new reproduction, matched-compute superiority or frontier-model superiority established by this factory.

findings.finding: RCWM PREREG-2 ledger decision regret 0.544 to 0.056; four-step exact state 0.029 to 0.698.
findings.scope: 150 fresh ledger parents; fixed unmerged T2 seed-0 adapter; same generator and marginals; chain_one horizon four.
limitations: Fresh payloads are not an OOD rule-mastery claim.
Prerequisite copy shortcut persisted; register was not fixed.
Registered forgetting guard is limited and does not show general retained competence.

findings.finding: RCWM PREREG-3 returned TRIGGER: unseen no-op status strata achieved 0.01-0.18 versus trained void 0.99-1.00.
findings.scope: Ledger in one frame; three T2 seeds; 1,500 one-step audit rows and 80 four-step chains described in the report.
limitations: Not every possible status or causal rule was tested.
Rule-text inversion was explicitly excluded from this confirmation; it is proposed new data here, not an established PREREG-3 test result.
Arithmetic, renamed word accounts and key order also showed restricted generalization.

findings.finding: L8-15 failed C2 prerequisite acquisition: 96/128 to 88/128; verdict DO NOT PROMOTE.
findings.scope: PREREG-L1 promotion screen; localization had reduced some activation drift.
limitations: Reduced drift does not prove preservation of exact numeric output, acquisition or deployability.
The earlier localization mechanism finding is exploratory and cannot override the failed screen.

findings.finding: BWM surface audit: canonical accuracy 1.000; reversed JSON keys 0.458; unseen block names 0.992 and shuffled fact lists 1.000.
findings.scope: 120 generated keys at 5 and 10 blocks, reported in joint R16.
limitations: A separate diagnostic; does not invalidate the canonical frozen 73/110 result.
Size, name and serialization invariance are distinct axes.

findings.finding: Per-row trace-matched filler length leaked wrap/branch labels; D-36 amendment 4b fixes filler length per public family/domain and action kind.
findings.scope: T2b and BWM trace-control kits; preserve literal cmp/calc/after target ordering.
limitations: This is a control-design correction, not a demonstrated new dataset learning benefit.
For this factory, choose any new filler policy from TRAIN only; do not copy a test-derived maximum.

findings.finding: D-36 retention no-go on corrected category loss, category net below -11, or pooled net below -4%, under both graders.
findings.scope: Existing registered retention workflow; old -5/75 category rule is diagnostic.
limitations: This factory does not open or recreate the protected retention instrument.
No detected loss is not proof of a <=2 percentage point noninferiority bound.

findings.finding: IDR role-specific routing infrastructure is documented as CPU-tested; native Rineya efficacy remains unqualified.
findings.scope: Bundle repository-source entry R05, not a local ChatBubble code audit.
limitations: RHF/triadic memory/CSS/RHD/recurrence are overlap candidates only; local executability is not established.
